tool_description: List owner-scoped GHOST memory metadata without returning complete stored episode bodies.

Use list_mode memories for the existing general saved-memory list, collections to discover Collection IDs and descriptions, or collection_episodes with an exact Collection ID to list that Collection's numbered episode metadata, Recall Keys, descriptions, and permanent number gaps.
server_instruction: Use ghost_memory_list only for metadata discovery. Use list_mode collections when the user wants to discover Collection identities. Use list_mode collection_episodes with the exact Collection ID when the user wants the contents index of one Collection. Use list_mode memories for the general saved-memory index.
Do not present List results as complete recalled Q/A content. Use ghost_memory_recall when the user asks for complete episodes.
When presenting Collections, use highest_assigned_episode_number as Episodes instead of record_count.
Also present Missing episodes. Show the missing episode numbers when gaps exist; otherwise show Missing episodes: empty.

field_descriptions.list_mode: Select memories for the general memory index, collections for Collection containers, or collection_episodes with an exact Collection ID for one Collection's numbered metadata index.
field_descriptions.collection_id: The exact stable Collection ID required by list_mode collection_episodes.
